sentences.text: A perusal of the record shows that a penalty was imposed under Section 52 of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short "the Act").

At the very outset, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State raised a preliminary objection and stated that the petitioner has got an alternative remedy under Section 76 of the Act to file an appeal, as such, this writ petition is not maintainable on the ground of alternative remedy.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
